text.tspan: Inside one eval run: phases, not a per-
question loop
Why phases: embedder, reranker and generator
do not fit in 8 GB together, so a per-
question loop reloaded a model on every
question. Phases give each stage the card
alone: two swaps per run instead of two per
question
Interactive answers stay a straight line: one
question cannot be batched, and the agent
decides for itself when to search
one embeddings batch for the whole set
(bge-m3)
hybrid search per question, wide pool when
reranking
flatten to pairs: 100 questions x 20
candidates = 2000

g.text: one predict for all of them, fp16 on the card
slice scores back per question, keep top k
